summary: Jund enrage dinosaurs: ping your own creatures, grow +1/+1 counters, and burn the table with Pestilence-style chaos.

tags.name: enrage
tags.reason: Damage-to-your-creatures is the repeating action and the commander payoff.

tags.name: +1/+1 counters
tags.reason: Rite of Passage, Level Up, Scythecat Cub, and Indoraptor itself grow from the pings.

tags.name: burn
tags.reason: Boltwave, Flame Rift, Pestilence, Pyrohemia, and Last Laugh point at faces.

tags.name: dinosaurs
tags.reason: Indoraptor plus several enrage dinosaurs and dino ramp.

tags.name: pingers
tags.reason: Repeatable pings are how enrage, Last Laugh, and the commander fire.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Symmetric Pestilence/Pyrohemia/Last Laugh turns the table into a damage lottery.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Last Laugh plus a wide or dying board is a deterministic table kill, not the only plan.

tags.name: group slug
tags.reason: The same damage engines tax every opponent while you grow.
